newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle steady-off $3 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle steady-off $3 - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were mostly steady, except 300-400 lbs which were $2.00-$3.00 per cwt lower, USDA said. Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 300-600 lb feeder steers and heifers. Supply included around 5 percent cows and bulls, 20 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs compared to last week.

Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 500-600 lbs 72.25-81.00, two pkgs 86.00-87.00, pkg replacements 93.00; 600-700 lbs 70.00-78.50; few 700-775 lbs 70.00-73.50, pkg 72.50. Medium and Large 1-2 - 600-800 lbs 61.00-68.50. Receipts - 907 Last Week - 910 Last Year - 2,917
